state.task: Fix confirmed FileBlade v0.2.0 terminal-pane failure during real isolated evidence capture.
facts: A real foot terminal runs tmux -L fileblade-capture attach -t evidence. The tmux client is a descendant of foot but the detached server and its panes are not.
FileBlade correctly classifies tmux from the client process but environment-based TMUX discovery returns empty, because the client was launched outside tmux.

Validation will use real tmux attached to a PTY and public drop context, plus the real nested compositor recording. No mocked unit tests.
